title: Audit archive handoff & certification playbook
creator: Aisha Mehta
description:
Problem: Customers and auditors require provable, tamper-evident handoff of admin audit data (admin actions, privileged access events, and configuration changes) with clear residency and retention controls. Current exports are ad-hoc, lack signed manifests, and do not provide an automated certification/archive workflow for legal or regulatory requests.

Goal: Deliver an automated playbook and implementation pattern (archive-attestator + handoff API) that: (1) bundles admin audit events into residency-tagged, append-only archives; (2) stamps each archive with an HSM-backed cryptographic attestation and signed manifest; (3) writes to WORM-capable storage and retains legal metadata; (4) exposes a proof-of-integrity API and scheduled certification reports for compliance teams.

Scope: engineering delivery of archive bundler, manifest signer integration (KMS/HSM), S3/Glacier-compatible WORM exporter, residency-aware retention manifest, and an evidence-reporting job that emits periodic certification bundles and searchable attestations. Does NOT include UI console work (separate ticket) or enterprise escrow legal agreements (coordination only).

Success metrics:
- Automated archive exports with signed manifests covering 100% of admin events for Dedicated and Private by target date.
- Attestation verification passes in <5s for typical archive size.
- Certification job produces monthly report and stores signed digest in anchor storage (HSM) with immutable retention metadata.
acceptance_criteria:
- Audit event bundler produces deterministic, residency-tagged archive files (NDJSON) with content-addressable filenames.
- Each archive has an attached signed manifest (SHA256 digests for each file + global digest) signed via HSM-backed key and stored alongside the archive.
- Exporter writes to WORM-capable bucket with retention policy set per residency policy and returns a signed handoff receipt.
- Evidence API: given an archive ID, verifier endpoint returns canonical manifest, signature, and HSM-stamped timestamp.
- Certification job runs on schedule, emits a human- and machine-readable certification bundle, and uploads a copy to the compliance-escrow location.
- Unit & integration tests covering signature verification, residency enforcement, and export retry/failover scenarios.
tasks: Design archive bundler spec: format, sharding, and deterministic ordering
Integrate KMS/HSM signer library and provide signing service endpoint
Implement residency-aware metadata tagging and retention policy enforcement
Build WORM exporter module with safe-write, manifest-attach, and retention-set steps
Create Evidence API for verification and a CLI helper for auditors
Add certification job (monthly) and a dashboard telemetry event for success/failure
Write integration tests and an end-to-end harness against a staging WORM bucket
Document runbook for incident response on failed exports and signature mismatches
runbook: Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/infrastructure/runbooks/archive-handoff. Contains failure modes, remediation steps, and verified-playback procedure for auditors.
